name: Sergei Pavlovich
summary: A Russian heavyweight from Eagles MMA (21-3, age 34) with one of the division's hardest right hands. After losing to Tom Aspinall (R1 KO) and Alexander Volkov (decision), he won decisions over Rozenstruik and Cortes-Acosta and knocked out Tallison Teixeira in 39 seconds in May. He has promised Alex Pereira 'surprises'.

how_they_fight.Striking: Explosive overhand rights and blitzes. All 16 of his knockouts came in R1.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Rarely wrestles; strong enough to defend takedowns.
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped once (Aspinall, R1). Volkov out-pointed him at range.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Five decision wins, three of them recent: he can go three rounds, but his danger is early.

patterns: Decision wins when the early blitz doesn't land
concerns: Knocked out in R1 by a faster heavyweight (Aspinall)
keys_to_beat: Survive the first five minutes and work him at range

news.text: Teased 'surprises' for Alex Pereira and released a training video.
